Comment [teacher1]: the

Mr William has been obese since childhood time. He has a strong family history of obesity. Moreover, he
has a medical history of type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypertension, sleep apnea and gout. Accordingly, he has
been commenced on insulin, metformin, atorvastatin, lisinopril, nifedipine and allopurinol.

Regarding Mr William weight history, he reported gaining weight every decade. He tried many weight-loss
programs but he failed. He used to eat 3 meals every day, and the dinner has been his main meal. He also
mentioned that he has had a habit of excessive eating related to stress. His examination revealed a BMI of
46.6 kg/m2 and a height of 155 c. m. It is worth mentioning that he was afraid of bariatric surgery before
because of complications. However, now, he wants to improve his health to get better life.

In view of the above, I would appreciate your further evaluation and management for Mr Williams'
condition as you see appropriate.

Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,

Doctor
